ja: －－－　フリーダムガンダム フルバーストモードを３種の拡張エフェクトで再現！　－－－
フリーダムガンダム フルバーストモードを躍動感溢れる３種のエフェクトで再現！
新規デザインを収録した水転写デカールが付属！！
※この商品にＭＳ本体は含まれません。
●　ＥＦＦＥＣＴ
各武装から照射されるビームを３色のエフェクトで再現！　躍動感あふれる３種類（計５本）の形状。
華やかなクリア成形を採用。
●　ＤＥＣＡＬ
本体ＭＳ用の２種類のマーキング（選択式）が水転写デカールで付属。
通常版のマーキングに加え、
「ガンプラビルダーズワールドカップ2013」世界チャンピオン・山内俊平氏デザインの新規デザインマーキングを収録！
シルバー部分には特色印刷色を採用。
【　セット内容　】
• 拡張エフェクト　・・・　計５本
・　キャノン砲エフェクト （クリアレッド×２）
・　腰部レール砲エフェクト （クリアイエロー×２）
・　ビームライフルエフェクト （クリアグリーン×１）
• 水転写デカール　・・・　２デザイン（選択式）収録

en: --- Freedom Gundam Full Burst Mode is reproduced with 3 types of extended effects! ---
Freedom Gundam Full Burst Mode is reproduced with 3 types of dynamic effects!
A water slide decal with a new design is included! !
*This product does not include the MS body.
● EFFECT
The beam emitted from each weapon is reproduced with three-color effects! Three types of shapes (total of 5 pieces) full of dynamism.
Adopts gorgeous clear molding.
● DECAL
Two types of markings (selectable) for the main body MS are included as water slide decals.
In addition to the regular version Marking,
Contains new design markings designed by "Gunpla Builders World Cup 2013" world champion Shunpei Yamauchi!
A special printing color is used for the silver part.
[Set contents]
• Extended effects: 5 total
・Cannon effect (clear red x 2)
・ Waist rail gun effect (clear yellow x 2)
・ Beam rifle effect (clear green x 1)
• Water transfer decal... 2 designs (selectable) included
[Compatible items]
MG 1/100 Freedom Gundam Ver.2.0 (sold separately/20164 Release in-store sales item)
* It also supports variation items using the same kit.
This product is jointed with "MG 1/100 Freedom Gundam Ver.2.0" (*sold separately/20164 Release in-store sales item),
An expanded effect set for reproducing the full burst mode scene from the movie.
This product does not include the MS body.
*Each weapon that joints expansion effects is included with the main product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, this product and "MG 1/100 Freedom Gundam Ver.2.0" (*sold separately/in-store item) are required.
Additionally, "MG 1/100 Freedom Gundam Ver.2.0" (*sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. The main product (sold separately) is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Due to the manufacturing process, air bubbles may appear in the clear parts.
